title: Media Studies, B.A. — Media Effects Option (Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications)
notes: Media Effects Option, University Park (of three: Film and Television Studies, Media Effects, Society and Culture -- Media Effects chosen for the cleanest elective pools: a single 4-way 'COMM 325/326/327/328' pool vs. the other two options' larger, less-defined 'COMM 400-level Film/Television' or 'Communication Theory' pools spanning 7-15 course codes). Major code MDST since the Film Production and Media Studies department has no single course-code prefix of its own. Extended comm_catalog.json with COMM 100N/118/270/304/305/325/326/405/413W/418. 'BA Fields' (9 credits, Smeal-style breadth requirement), 'World Language' (4cr x3), 'PSU 9', and generic 'Elective' pools are modeled generically, same convention as CMPSC's own open pools. Cross-checked against the live 2026-27 bulletin's own 'Requirements for the Major' course list for the Media Effects option (no separate department handbook exists beyond the bulletin for this major). Found and fixed 2 real gaps that the original build's own notes had flagged as open uncertainties: (1) COMM 327 and COMM 328 ARE confirmed on the real Media Effects 'select 6 credits' elective list (COMM 325/326/327/328, verified directly from the bulletin's Requirements-for-the-Major course list, not just the Suggested Plan) and both have no catalog prereqs -- widened both elective items' options from the 2-course {325,326} pair to the full real 4-course list. (2) The 'Cinema or Media Course' pool per the same authoritative Requirements-for-the-Major list is actually COMM 110/150N/180/320/403/412 -- COMM 205 (present in the original plan's notes) is not actually on it, likely picked up from the bulletin's own less-authoritative Suggested-Plan-table footnote, which lists COMM 205 as an extra choice the Requirements section itself omits; widened the item's options to the verified 6-course list instead of the single hardcoded COMM 403.
